name: Asymmetric Embedding Instruction Contract
mechanism: Pins distinct query and passage prefixes, tokenizer, pooling and normalization as part of the immutable index identity.
use_when: The encoder was trained with asymmetric retrieval instructions
Multiple services produce queries or passage vectors
avoid_when: The model explicitly documents symmetric encoding
The deployed model card does not specify an instruction contract
expected_effects: Early detection of silent client mismatch
failure_modes: Query and passage prefixes are swapped
Pooling differs between indexing and serving
A model upgrade silently changes tokenization
